scoring_contract.rule: A criterion passes only when every material conjunct is explicit; omitted routing, evidence classes, unknowns, deferrals, owners, safeguards, measures, dates, switch conditions, and handoffs are not inferred.

stage_a_corrections.reason: Days 6-15 schedule build/test work, unrelated work is frozen, clinic-user contact recurs across the plan, and the normal-workweek/no-nights rule supplies the recovery cadence.
Functional owners, Days 1-5 baselines, the 22%-to-50% target, twice-weekly and end-week checkpoints, Days 26-30 decision, and continue/adjust/pivot conditions satisfy the criterion.

result.red_validity_reason: Every case misses at least one strict conjunctive criterion.

decisions.rationale: Founder attention and reliable service explicitly lead the four-week plan; runway, no fundraise, and retained decision rights keep survival, capital, and authority redesign secondary.

The fact/assertion/unknown partition is incomplete: the 31-hour use and three-week defect age are not explicitly inventoried, both founder claims are not separately classified, and retention impact and each obligation's value are not named unknowns.
The response explicitly declares two company priorities rather than one state-changing sync outcome, despite strong deferrals.
Customer and company time are protected and external activity is capped, but no total-hours or recovery boundary prevents workload expansion.
Complete baselines, calendar-dated weekly reviews, explicit switch evidence, and a dated continue/revise/replace close are absent.
Customer behavior leads, competitor and team conclusions are treated as non-evidence, and both abandonment and unchanged overwork are rejected.
Observed clinic, adoption, procurement, feedback, demo, and pilot evidence is separated from conclusions, with causality, repeatability, friction, qualification, and launch bottlenecks tested.
One objective is stated, but workflow changes, launch/procurement, qualification, and measurement remain parallel primary tactics rather than one tactic aimed at one highest-leverage unknown.
Days 6-15 schedule build/test work, unrelated work is frozen, clinic-user contact recurs across the plan, and a normal workweek with no mandatory nights restores sustainable cadence.
Functional owners, Days 1-5 baselines, the 22%-to-50% target, twice-weekly and end-week checkpoints, Days 26-30 decision, and continue/adjust/pivot conditions complete the cycle.
The conference is explicitly rejected as an emergency, and sustained overload is tied to degraded decisions and output under non-survival conditions.
The exact 78-hour baseline is omitted and minimum conference value and recoverable decision capacity are not named as evidence-seeking unknowns.
Conference delivery, approval redesign, release stabilization, customer contact, and workload recovery remain co-primary rather than one stabilizing monthly outcome.
Recovery, delegation, and user-contact safeguards are concrete, but no recurring protected maker-time period is established.
Complete baselines, precise switch thresholds, and a dated close contingent on sustained recovery evidence are absent.
Solvency and payroll survival explicitly precede calendar and morale work until an executable survival envelope exists.
Cash, obligations, gross profit, payroll, renewal, and bridge uncertainty are handled correctly, but clear product ownership is omitted from the explicit known-fact inventory.
A viable survival decision is primary, while calendar redesign, morale programming, speculative features, broad strategy, and unrelated spend are deferred.
Essential payroll, legal, customer, and product continuity is protected, but backup decision coverage and crisis-team workload/recovery safeguards are absent.
Decision and evidence owners, tomorrow's checkpoint, measurable survival branches, escalation, closure, and the funded-or-executable focus handoff are explicit.
Authority redesign is explicitly the root workflow and personal focus is placed after decision-rights definition as a supporting action.
The exact runway and no-fundraise facts are omitted, and retained authority limits and residual CEO capacity are not explicitly classified as unknowns to test.
Productivity tooling is allowed in week two, while broad meeting cancellation and unrelated changes are not explicitly deferred behind an evidence condition.
Transfers, escalation, incident command, commitment gates, and backup delegation are staged, but sustainable CEO user time and an explicit released-capacity workload boundary are absent.
Full baselines, explicit keep/expand/rollback conditions, and a specific later-focus handoff after authority closure are incomplete.
The live financing decision explicitly leads for two weeks, with product/customer cadence and morale work resuming after resolution or reset.
The customer count, runway, round size, and process age are omitted from the explicit fact inventory, and close probability is not named as an unknown.
The two qualified paths serve one financing decision, while low-fit introductions and optional partnership, product, productivity, and morale work are deferred.
Named-role coverage, daytime batching, evening cutoff, controlled exceptions, and compensatory recovery bound the two-week sprint.
Owners, deadline gates, accept/extend/decline branches, live-round reset, and the dated handoff back to product/customer cadence complete the cycle.
